aura_anim_00_spark_in: Animation $00: 4 frames, hold 7, groups sprite_group_17903C ... 17908D (two 8x8 sub-sprites each, tile words $0460-$0466). The first stage of the grow-in and the last of the shrink.
aura_anim_01_grow: Animation $01: 4 frames, hold 7, groups sprite_group_1790A8 ... 17910E (three sub-sprites each, tile words $044C-$044F, $045E-$045F, $0467-$046F). The second stage of the grow-in and the first of the shrink.
aura_anim_02_orbit: Animation $02: 4 frames, hold 7, groups sprite_group_179130 ... 17918F (16x16 pairs in frames 0, 1 and 3, four 8x8 tiles in frame 2). The loop that runs while the orbit is active.
dark_friar_00_cast_flash: Animation $00, cast flash: 9 frames, hold 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 3, 3, 3, 0 (about 20 ticks).
dark_friar_01_trail1: Animation $01, first trail stage: 3 frames, hold 0.
dark_friar_02_trail2: Animation $02, second trail stage: 3 frames, hold 0.
dark_friar_03_trail3: Animation $03, final trail stage (with hitbox): 4 frames, hold 0.
dark_friar_06_follower_b: Animation $06, TrailFollowerSprB: 4 frames, hold 1, pulsing 0, 1, 2, 1 (the same groups as $01).
freedan_fx_00_drop_fall: Animation $00, vine drop attack fall: 4 frames, hold 2. Staged by ClimbDropAttack with a hitbox.
freedan_fx_01_drop_land: Animation $01, vine drop landing: 6 frames, hold 4 for the first five and 9 for the last. Staged by ClimbDropLand.
freedan_fx_02_aura_cast: Animation $02, Aura Barrier cast: 2 frames, hold 4. Staged once at the start of the cast.
freedan_fx_03_aura_sustain: Animation $03, Aura Barrier sustain: 1 frame, hold 9, looped for the length of the barrier.
projectile_launch_east: Animation $03, East launch: 3 frames (hold 5, 2, 2). Used by ProjectileEast (#03).
projectile_launch_north: Animation $01, North launch: 3 frames (hold 5, 2, 2). Used by ProjectileNorth (#01).
projectile_launch_south: Animation $00, South launch: 3 frames (hold 5, 2, 2 ticks + 1 each). Used by ProjectileSouth (#00).
projectile_launch_west: Animation $02, West launch: 3 frames (hold 5, 2, 2). Used by ProjectileWest (#02).
projectile_travel_east: Animation $07, East travel loop: one frame (hold 9) = last group of animation $03.
projectile_travel_north: Animation $05, North travel loop: one frame (hold 9) = last group of animation $01.
projectile_travel_south: Animation $04, South travel loop: one frame (hold 9) = last group of animation $00.
projectile_travel_west: Animation $06, West travel loop: one frame (hold 9) = last group of animation $02.
shadow_aura_anim_abort: Animation $01, 19 records: the groups of $00 in reverse order, from the smallest (17C1EC) back to the large body group 17C0E8 (last hold $13). Shown by the abort branch of the Aura sequence.
shadow_aura_anim_land_loop: Animation $02, 16 records, all hold 0: the groups 17C3DE, 17C406, 17C3F2 and 17C406 (two records each) alternate with the one-sprite group 17C42F. Staged with Y chain 1 while the player sinks.
shadow_aura_anim_sink: Animation $00, 20 records: the large body group 17C0E8 for 20 ticks, five shrinking groups (holds 5, 5, 4, 4, 3), thirteen small groups of 2 ticks each, and the closing one-sprite group 17C42F.
shadow_fx_04: Animation $04: 8 frames (hold 3, 3, 3, 6, 4, 3, 2, 0), the longest list of the set.
shadow_fx_05: Animation $05: one frame, hold 31, group 17B098 (same as $07, $08, $0A, $0B, $0D).
sprite_group_17903C: Example group: animation $00, frame 0. Header: extents X 4 / 4, Y 8 / 8, default attack box, body box $FC $08 $F8 $16, 2 sub-sprites (8x8, tile words $0460 and $0464, offsets (0,8) and (8,0)).
sprite_group_17C0E8: The large body group: 6 sub-sprites, first record of $00 and last of $01.
sprite_group_17C42F: One sub-sprite (tile word $041E, offsets 0,0): the closing record of $00 and every second frame of $02.
spriteset_aura: 3 pointers to the frame lists, indexed by the animation number staged by AuraProjectileChild / AuraProjectileShrink: $00 and $01 grow-in, $02 the looping orbit. See the block note.
spriteset_dark_friar: 7 pointers to the animation frame lists: $00 cast flash, $01-$03 trail stages, $04 fragment, $05 and $06 trail followers.
spriteset_darkgaia_projectile: 8 pointers to the animation frame lists: $00-$03 = launch South/North/West/East, $04-$07 = travel loop in the same order.
spriteset_freedan_fx: 4 pointers to the animation frame lists: $00 vine drop fall, $01 drop landing, $02 Aura Barrier cast, $03 Aura Barrier sustain pose.
spriteset_shadow_aura_body: Animation table of the Aura body (body_table row $08), 3 pointers: $00 = the body turning to water (played once), $01 = the same groups in reverse (the abort path), $02 = 16 one-tick frames played while the player sinks (Y +1 px per frame). The caller of all three is player_transition_handlers.PlayerAuraTransformEntry.
spriteset_shadow_fx: 14 pointers to the animation frame lists ($00-$0D). Nothing stages any of them (see the block note).
